head.text: WF-008 — Reset and accepted zeroize abort pending output and error

foot.text: The example starts with an output/error record already valid. At E0, i_zeroize_req is sampled high; the same edge aborts work, clears sensitive state and output/error valid bits, and discards the pending error record. No error code is emitted; o_zeroize_done is high for the one-cycle interval immediately after E0. AES no-stall latency is L_PIPE=10.
